fields.fieldText:
REQUEST TO CREATE A NEW CONTACT

 

Please approach any TEAM LEAD or any POINT OF CONTACT and request to create the contact for this account.

Please ensure to provide the following information:

  • RC User ID
  • Contact Name
  • Email Address
  • Contact Number

Once they have confirmed that the contact has been successfully added, click NEXT.

 

NOTE: By clicking NEXT, you will be routed back to the previous screen.

If the email address does not show up in the list, choose REQUEST TO CREATE A NEW CONTACT to refresh it.

If nothing happens after refreshing the list, it means that the contact has not yet been added.
